skill.name: xhs-trend-insights-v2
skill.description: Use SocialDataX to review the Xiaohongshu hot list, search for notes, and turn sampled evidence into content ideas.
skill.summary: Track RedNote trends and find content ideas backed by examples.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most backtick alerts are Markdown, but the skill runs an unpinned npm package that can access SocialDataX credentials. The search example puts user input in a shell command, and the output rules require sharing full links with tokens. No evidence found of embedded secrets, obfuscation, or instructions targeting the audit.

remediation.issue: The CLI runs an unpinned npm package in an environment with credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Pin and verify a reviewed release before execution. Require approval for installation and isolate the CLI from unrelated files and secrets.

remediation.issue: The search example does not establish a safe boundary between the keyword and shell syntax.
remediation.suggestion: Pass keywords and pagination tokens as separate arguments through a shell-free process API, or use the configured MCP tool with typed parameters.

remediation.issue: The CLI stores a service key in a user configuration file and reads credentials at runtime.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer an OS credential store or managed secret injection with a scoped key. Verify private permissions and keep secret values out of logs.

remediation.issue: The output rules require full token-bearing note URLs even for storage and forwarding.
remediation.suggestion: Use note IDs for reports and exports by default. Include full links only when necessary and approved for the intended recipient.

remediation.issue: The balance error flow prefers a URL from the service response without an explicit validation step.
remediation.suggestion: Use the fixed SocialDataX billing URL, or validate the exact HTTPS origin and billing path before displaying an error-supplied link.

content.value_statement: A hot list shows what is popular now, but it may not explain what matters to your audience. Compare ranked topics with keyword search samples to find content directions backed by examples.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve the current Xiaohongshu hot list without a keyword.
Search notes by keyword and filter by content type or publication window.
Sort search samples by recency, likes, comments, or saves.
Limit CLI searches by pages or items and resume a search using its continuation token.
Summarize topic patterns, creator angles, and audience signals separately from recommendations.
Report partial results and state when a search did not finish.
limitations: Live data requires a SocialDataX credential for the CLI or an authenticated SocialDataX MCP connection.
Some requests consume SocialDataX credits. Low balances and service errors can interrupt a search.
Search samples and hot-list snapshots do not represent all Xiaohongshu activity.
Platform research is read-only. The skill does not publish, like, comment on, or modify Xiaohongshu accounts.

use_cases.title: Plan an editorial calendar
use_cases.description: Use current rankings and relevant notes to select topics for the next editorial meeting.

use_cases.title: Research product positioning
use_cases.description: Group sampled notes by audience concerns and identify claims that need more research.

use_cases.title: Find a new video angle
use_cases.description: Review recent videos on a topic and use recurring questions to propose a distinct follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Review today's hot topics
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the current Xiaohongshu hot list. Summarize the top five topics and keep your interpretation separate from the rankings.

prompt_templates.title: Sample notes for a keyword
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Xiaohongshu for [keyword] and review one page of recent image notes. Group three samples by angle and cite their note IDs.

prompt_templates.title: Compare the hot list with recent videos
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the current hot list with one page of recent videos about [topic]. Present each source separately and propose two content ideas supported by examples.

prompt_templates.title: Build a bounded research brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the CLI to sample notes about [topic] from the past seven days. Sort by comments and stop after two pages or 20 notes. Report sample limits, partial results, recurring questions, and three ideas to test.
prompt_templates.scenario: Evidence review with a fixed collection scope

output_examples.input: Review the hot list and suggest a home organization topic.
output: Illustrative hot-list signal: Small-space storage appears in the current ranking.
Suggested angle: Show three ways to organize an entryway without adding furniture.
Evidence limit: The ranking shows current attention, not a sustained trend.

output_examples.input: Review one page of Xiaohongshu notes about reusable lunch boxes.
output: Illustrative sample finding: Notes emphasize leak prevention and ease of cleaning.
Suggested angle: Compare two lid styles in a simple everyday test.
Sample limit: The first results page does not establish how common these concerns are across the platform.

best_practices: Start with one page and agree on a research limit before collecting more results.
Label hot-list rankings, search evidence, and editorial recommendations separately.
Use note IDs in shared briefs instead of full links with tokens.
anti_patterns: Treating a snapshot or a filtered sample as proof of a platform-wide trend.
Pasting a SocialDataX API key into a chat, prompt, or shared document.
Restarting a paid search from page one after a partial result without checking the continuation token and remaining limits.

faq.question: Do I need a keyword?
faq.answer: The hot list does not need a keyword. Note search needs a keyword or focused topic.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs a SocialDataX key in its execution environment. An existing authenticated SocialDataX MCP connection does not need a separate local CLI key.

faq.question: Can I restrict the research to recent posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Use supported publication windows, or use the CLI to filter the fetched sample to a specific number of days.

faq.question: Can it post or interact with accounts?
faq.answer: No. It retrieves trend and note data without publishing posts, liking notes, or changing an account.

faq.question: What happens if a request returns partial results?
faq.answer: Keep the items already returned and mark the sample incomplete. Resume only with a valid continuation token and the remaining collection limits.

faq.question: What happens if my SocialDataX balance is low?
faq.answer: Stop retrying and check the balance in the official SocialDataX dashboard. Resume only after resolving the billing error.
